about: Meshy asset queue and log (docs/MESHY.md). Free plan: 100 credits/month (resets the 1st, 00:00 UTC, no rollover), 10 downloads/month of untextured Meshy 6 Lite models, CC BY 4.0 (credit Meshy). A Lite preview costs 5 credits, so 20 previews buy 10 downloads: two tries per asset. status: queued -> generated -> checked (or 'too heavy') -> uploaded -> placed, or rejected.
